interaction: Drag or tap move forward, turn left, turn right and repeat ×2 blocks into a program (keys F/L/R/P also work), press Run and watch the robot step across a 6×6 grid to the star — three levels with walls and block limits, bumps when it hits a wall, confetti when it arrives.
notes: Repeat blocks can't be nested (level 3 needs two of them). Confetti and robot easing are off under reduced motion. Programs, camp dates and prices are samples; the enrol form ends in a demo toast.
